examples.en: The children rarely misbehave during art lessons.
examples.zh: 孩子们在美术课上很少调皮。

examples.en: People sometimes misbehave when they think no one is watching.
examples.zh: 有些人认为没人看着时会行为不当。

parts.text: when they think no one is watching.

hints.label: 回忆练习
hints.text: 暂时遮住释义，回想词义后再核对；需要提示时，可以选择“不认识”继续复习。
